edit.description: PriorAttemptStore.readAll — narrow the readdir catch to ENOENT, rethrow the rest; correct the doc's read() precedent
the refusal leg and the absent-dir leg

summary: PriorAttemptStore.readAll swallows every readdir failure as "no records" — narrow to ENOENT and let the rest escape
tests: readAll refuses when the prior-attempts dir is present but unreadable
pins: readAll reads an absent prior-attempts dir as no records
acceptance: An unreadable prior-attempts dir escapes readAll instead of reporting an empty map; an absent one still reads as no records.
notes: src/priorAttempts.ts:271's bare catch feeds TickContext.priorAttempts (src/Dispatcher.ts:1771, :2475), so an unreachable dir tells every shouldRun "no prior attempt" — the signal read() at :213 says must refuse rather than reset. The site cites read() as its precedent, but read() throws via existsLoud. Match src/job.ts:jobStatus's split. Repro without chmod: a plain file at <flumeDir>/prior-attempts gives ENOTDIR.
